description: A mixed run - three transactions, two posted and one rejected - which is the only shape that shows both count lines carrying different numbers and RETURN-CODE 4 arrived at with real work already committed. DALYTRAN is dailytran rows 0 to 2 verbatim. XREFFILE resolves all three cards, to accounts 20, 7 and 5. ACCTFILE holds accounts 7 and 20 but NOT account 5, so the third transaction rejects with 101 while the first two post. Row 0 goes to account 7 and rewrites key (7,01,0001) to +504.77; row 1 is the type 03 record, so its key (20,03,0001) is absent, the not-found line is displayed and the record is created at -919.00; row 2 never reaches a writing paragraph. WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT is incremented at :206 for every record read, rejected or not, so the first count line reads 000000003 while the second reads 000000001 - and :229's test is on the reject count, so RETURN-CODE is 4 even though two transactions were posted successfully and stay posted. There is no rollback anywhere in this program. ONE SUBTLETY THIS CASE PINS AND case08 CANNOT: the record 2700-A creates here carries TWENTY-TWO ZEROS in its FILLER, not the twenty-two spaces case08's created record carries. INITIALIZE at :504 leaves FILLER alone, and READ ... INTO transfers nothing on INVALID KEY, so the reserved bytes are whatever the area already held - and by the time record 1 misses its key, record 0's successful READ has already filled that area with tcatbal row 6, whose FILLER is zeros. In case08 no read had succeeded yet, so the area was still the freshly allocated one and the created record carried spaces. Same paragraph, same INITIALIZE, two different sets of reserved bytes, decided entirely by what was read before.
